# data.docker_stack

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Reads the services of one Swarm stack, like `docker stack services`: mode, `running/desired` replicas, image and published ports per service. Tasks are not listed; use `data.docker_tasks` with the `com.docker.stack.namespace` label.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | SHA-256 of services_json, to detect drift without diffing the document. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version of the daemon (GET /version Version). |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon for this read/apply. |
| `images` | `map(string)` | computed |  |  | Map of short service name to its image (digest pin removed, as the CLI shows it). |
| `name` | `string` | required |  |  | The stack namespace. |
| `service_ids` | `map(string)` | computed |  |  | Map of short service name (without `<stack>_`) to service ID. |
| `services` | `list(object)` | computed |  |  | One entry per service: the `stack services` row plus the full spec. |
| `services_json` | `string` | computed |  | yes | Inspect of the stack's services as one JSON array (GET /services filtered by namespace). Sensitive: service env. |

## Example

```terraform
data "docker_stack" "shop" {
  name = "shop"
}

output "replicas" {
  value = { for s in data.docker_stack.shop.services : s.name => s.replicas }
}
```
